audit.whatIsWrong: The chart called levels 1 through 5 'Skill' while every one of whys[0..3] says the stage belongs to Graves, and both spikes[0] and early describe him running you over.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Skill, Locke, Skill]; the mirror audit has already been brought onto that chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 set to Graves at 4/10 and row 5 (Level 6) to Skill at 5/10 in both layers, as one atomic group. First item stays Locke.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] were written one row out of position — whys[4] describes 'level 5' on the Level 6 row, and whys[5] describes 'at 6' on the First item row.
audit.why: Row order is Level 1, 2, 3, 4-5, Level 6, First item, 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Both relabelled so the spike each row describes is the spike that row is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is called a blind in six places ('blind shuts off your P autos', 'blinds your autos', 'blind windows', 'W blind'). Smoke Screen does not blind — it reduces sight range and applies magic damage plus a brief slow on impact.
audit.why: Riot text: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' A blind would zero your autos; sight denial does not, so the correct play is completely different — your autos still land, you just cannot see him.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in whys[1], spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, early, late, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw's real cooldown never appeared, its magic resist was omitted (the page says armour only), and the passive's minion-block was never mentioned.
audit.why: Kit: E 16/15/14/13/12s, grants Armor AND Magic Resist, cooldown lowered by attacks. Passive: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.'
audit.corrected: report[5].t now carries the 16s rank-1 number, both resists, and the minion-line rule.

edits.after: Graves runs you over levels 1-4: End of the Line (Q) does heavy burst, Smoke Screen (W) slows on impact and blanks your vision of him, and Quickdraw (E, 16s) gives him armour, MR and a dash to win every early trade. Farm respectfully and don't E in while his kit is up.

edits.before: With items it's skill-based. Graves' auto damage is lethal, but your burst-and-execute pattern still deletes him if you catch him with W on cooldown; respect his blind and armor stacks and pick your engage rather than trading autos head-on.
edits.after: With items it's skill-based. Graves' auto damage is lethal, but your burst-and-execute pattern still deletes him if you catch him with W on cooldown; respect the smoke's slow and his resist stacks and pick your engage rather than trading head-on.

edits.before: Track Graves’s Quickdraw: Dash + armor stacks — burst him after the charges are spent. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track Quickdraw (16s at rank 1): dash plus armour and MR. His shotgun pellets cannot pass through units — hold the minion line.

notes: Smoke Screen was written as a blind throughout, which is the single most consequential error on the page: a blind would justify not auto-attacking at all, while the real effect is sight denial plus an impact slow, and your autos work fine inside it. Chart rows 1-4 also disagreed with their own whys text and with the packet; fixed as one paired group.
